server_root.description: Top-level directory where Apache configuration, logs, and modules are stored.

path.description: Relative or absolute path to module .so file

include_modules.description: List of modules to load. Each entry has name and path.

items.description: Directory path to include optional config snippets from

include_optional_dirs.description: Directories whose contents (*.conf) should be automatically included.

listen_address.description: IP address (or * for all interfaces) to bind to for incoming connections.

port.description: TCP port to listen on for HTTP traffic.

user.description: System user under which Apache processes run (security best practice: non-root).

group.description: System group under which Apache processes run.

server_admin.description: Email address shown in server-generated error pages and responses.

server_name.description: Server hostname and optional port (e.g., 'example.com:80'). Leave blank to auto-detect.

hostname_lookups.description: Enable DNS reverse lookups for client IPs ('On' or 'Off'). Recommended: 'Off' for performance.

error_log.description: Path to the main error log file.

log_level.description: Verbosity of error logs: emerg, alert, crit, error, warn, notice, info, debug.

error_documents.description: Mapping of HTTP status codes to custom error document paths.

mime_types_config.description: Path to the system MIME types configuration file.

directory_index.description: List of filenames Apache serves by default for directory requests.

document_root.description: Path to the directory containing site content.

directory_options.description: Options enabled for the DocumentRoot directory.

allow_override.description: Which directives in .htaccess files are allowed (e.g., 'All', 'None', 'AuthConfig').

php_handler.description: Handler for PHP files (e.g., 'proxy:unix:/run/php/php-fpm.sock|fcgi://localhost' for FPM).

pid_file.description: File to write the server’s process ID.

timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to receive requests or send responses before aborting.

max_keepalive_requests.description: Maximum number of requests allowed per persistent connection.

keepalive_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for additional requests on a persistent connection.

log_format_name.description: Name/alias for the custom log format.

format.description: Log format name (must match LogFormat alias)

access_logs.description: Access log configuration entries (one per log file).

cache_dir_levels.description: Depth of subdirectory hierarchy under CacheRoot.

cache_dir_length.description: Number of characters per subdirectory name.

cache_default_expire.description: Default cache lifetime in seconds (used when no expiration is specified).

cache_last_modified_factor.description: Factor to estimate freshness from last-modified timestamp (0.0–1.0).

url.description: URL path pattern to cache (e.g., '/' for all)

cache_enable.description: URL paths to cache, with storage type.

mime_types_extra.description: Additional MIME type mappings for file extensions.

server_signature.description: Include server version and virtual host name in server-generated pages (false = better security).

trace_enable.description: Enable HTTP TRACE method (false = recommended to prevent XST attacks).

items.description: Path pattern for virtual host config files
